processed.title: Best Resort Wear Dresses: 10 Styles Worth Packing

verification.h1: Best Resort Wear Dresses: 10 Styles Worth Packing

serpObservations.intent: Commercial listicle/search-to-shop intent with practical packing guidance.
serpObservations.pageTypes: Magazine/editorial commerce roundups, vacation dress outfit guides, resortwear brand lists and Amazon travel-dress lists.
serpObservations.approxLength: Most relevant results appear to be medium-to-long listicles, commonly 8-17 picks or style categories.
serpObservations.structure: Intro, editor context, product/style list, occasion categories, shopping notes and some care or packing tips.
serpObservations.coverage: Packability, day-to-night use, fabric, price, destination occasions, brand recommendations, accessories and summer trends.
serpObservations.authorSignals: Fashion editor bylines and publication editorial standards are common among top results.
serpObservations.multimedia: Product images and styled outfit imagery dominate; video was not consistently present in the relevant SERP.
serpObservations.entities: Harper's Bazaar, Vogue, ELLE, Southern Living, New York Post, Town & Country, Skin Cancer Foundation, FTC.
serpObservations.questions: What dresses should I pack, which fabrics work in heat, how many dresses for a trip, can coverups work beyond the beach, what is UPF.
serpObservations.gaps: Many SERP pages list products but do not give a neutral decision framework for choosing dress types by trip use, care and sun coverage.

processed.notes: No YouTube embed included because available relevant video results were not consistently surfaced for this query and a video was not necessary to satisfy intent.
